entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 词头为承接上页之残句“…tener cu tān che hūn che”，起首截断，H/M/R 三栏空白，无法定夺词义。

entries.zh: 兔子产仔时；兔初生之际
entries.en: when the rabbit gives birth; at the birth of rabbits
entries.notes: 短语式词头用法未详，M 栏音写 che loñ suahun 未解。

entries.zh: 收到它时；收受之际
entries.en: on receiving it; upon receipt

entries.zh: 憎恶；嫌恶；厌恶
entries.en: hatred, abhorrence; loathing

entries.zh: 付账、还钱（清偿债务）；亦指施肥、作保
entries.en: to pay, settle a debt; to fertilize, manure; to endorse, stand surety
entries.notes: 多义项并存，按马尼拉贸易语境以还债付款为主义；M 栏音写未解。

entries.zh: 流产；堕胎（未及月而产）
entries.en: miscarriage, abortion; premature delivery
entries.notes: 词头后段 aborran en ce 费解；M 栏 tay 音近“胎”。

entries.zh: 张开；裂开（自行绽开）
entries.en: to open, split open; to come open of itself

entries.zh: 燃烧；灼热
entries.en: to blaze, burn, scorch
entries.notes: 词头中 Lantō 所指未详，M 栏 pō 未解。

entries.zh: 烧灼；炙烤（词头疑截断，或为 Abrasar）
entries.en: to scorch, roast (headword apparently truncated)
entries.notes: 词头疑截；M 栏 tō suam 与第 7 条共享音节，未解。

entries.zh: 燃烧如火；火样炽燃
entries.en: blazing like fire; ablaze

entries.zh: 烧灼发热（calorcier 一语字义未详）
entries.en: to burn with heat ('calorcier' of unclear sense)
entries.notes: calorcier 非通行西语词形且 M 栏空白，按“发热灼热”推断。

entries.zh: 病中绽开（疑指疮痘或伤口在病人身上发开；确切语义存疑）
entries.en: 'to open up as a sick person'; exact sense uncertain
entries.notes: 西语短语费解，M 栏 vaxsier 未解，仅按字面推断。

entries.zh: 烧灼或相拥（Abrassarse 于 abrasarse／abrazarse 两可），Conguesmien 未详——释义存疑
entries.en: 'abrassarse' ambiguous between burning oneself and embracing; 'Conguesmien' undeciphered
entries.notes: 词头含未解字样，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: Abrassarse 两可（烧灼／相拥），Mamarrug.res 缩写未展开、义未详——释义存疑
entries.en: 'abrassarse a Mamarrug.res': qualifier unresolved (abbreviation mark), sense undeterminable
entries.notes: 缩写记号 .res 未展开，M 栏 xen chabon 未解。

entries.zh: 饮牲口；给牲畜饮水
entries.en: to water the livestock, give the beasts drink

entries.zh: 缩写；简写（书写从简）
entries.en: to abbreviate in writing; to write in shorthand

entries.zh: Abrevias Reumi chau 后半未详，语义无法定夺——释义存疑
entries.en: 'Abrevias Reumi chau' undeciphered composite; 'abrevias' appears verbal
entries.notes: 词头后半 Reumi chau 未详，M 栏 sū 未解。

entries.zh: 截短话头；令言者简短（打断其言）
entries.en: to cut short the speaker; to make him brief

entries.zh: 缩写；缩略式
entries.en: abbreviation; abbreviated form

entries.zh: 覆蔽；御寒保暖；庇护（自蔽）；外衣、庇护所
entries.en: to shelter, keep warm (oneself); a coat, shelter, protection
entries.notes: M 栏空白，释义仅据西语词头。

entries.zh: 四月（月份名）
entries.en: April (the month)
entries.notes: M 栏空白，释义仅据西语词头。

entries.zh: 打开（如此打开；M 栏可解作“開開”）
entries.en: to open, as (shown) here ('ut sic')

entries.zh: 掰开；扳开（分拆而开）
entries.en: to open by splitting apart, pry open

entries.zh: 摇开（M 栏可解作“搖開”；Callaga 未详）
entries.en: to shake open ('Callaga' unidentified)
entries.notes: 词头含未详字样 Callaga。

entries.zh: 睁眼；擘开眼睛
entries.en: to open the eye(s)

entries.zh: 睁开眼睛
entries.en: to open the eyes
entries.notes: algudos 疑为讹写，不影响“开目”主旨。

entries.zh: 兴讼；开案（提起诉讼）
entries.en: to open a case, institute a lawsuit

entries.zh: 翻书；开卷
entries.en: to open books

entries.zh: 掀帐；张帐（打开帐幔或蚊帐）
entries.en: to open the canopy or tent (mosquito-net)

entries.zh: 开山；凿岭成路
entries.en: to open up the hills, cut a way through

entries.zh: 开路；辟道
entries.en: to open roads, make a way

entries.zh: 开板；启板（或指打开写字之板）
entries.en: to open a board or plank; possibly a writing tablet

entries.zh: Abrir alguzeros 中 alguzeros 未详（疑为讹写）——释义存疑
entries.en: 'to open alguzeros': 'alguzeros' unidentified, likely a misreading
entries.notes: alguzeros 非通行西语词形，M 栏 carabi le cang cahān 未解。

entries.zh: 胀裂而开；待熟自绽
entries.en: to open as if waiting, bursting open (of ripening buds or fruits)

entries.zh: 拆信；启封（裂批拆封）
entries.en: to open a letter, break the seal

entries.zh: 蹲身擘开；屈身而张大张开
entries.en: to open or spread while crouching, spread wide open

entries.zh: 开果酱罐；启糖渍果品之罐
entries.en: to open a jar of preserved fruit (confiture)
entries.notes: Confidura 拼写异于通行之 confitura。

entries.zh: 开花；如玫瑰绽放
entries.en: to bloom, open like a rose

entries.zh: 开心；敞开心怀（打开心结）
entries.en: to open the heart, disclose oneself

entries.zh: 开花（Carube 所指未详，M 栏同第 38 条可解作“花开”）
entries.en: to bloom ('Carube' unidentified; Hokkien gloss 'flowers open')
entries.notes: 词头中 Carube 未详，但 M 栏音写与第 38 条同证“花开”。

entries.zh: 边点数边开（直译；确切所指存疑）
entries.en: 'to open counting': literal reading, exact referent unclear

entries.zh: 拧开；旋开
entries.en: to open by turning or twisting; unscrew

entries.zh: 吹开
entries.en: to open by blowing; blow open

entries.zh: 直译“数着打开”（与第 41 条同词头而 M 栏音写不同，确切义未详）
entries.en: 'to open counting': same headword as position 41 with a different gloss
entries.notes: 与第 41 条词头重复而 M 栏相异，二者关系未详。

entries.zh: 开路通商；为买卖开道
entries.en: to open the way for trade or business dealings

entries.zh: 解开绳线之头（Cabo Llana 疑指平散之末端）
entries.en: to open or unravel the end ('cabo llana' uncertain, likely a loose rope-end)
entries.notes: Cabo Llana 组合义未详，此为推断。

entries.zh: 开面（疑指开脸或露面；西语 mosto 疑为 rostro 之讹写）
entries.en: to open the face ('mosto' likely a slip for 'rostro', face)
entries.notes: M 栏可解作“開面”，与 mosto（新酒）不合，疑词头讹写。

entries.zh: 头一次开某物；首开（开个头）
entries.en: to open a thing for the first time; first opening
